name: Warpriest Divine Commander — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Warpriest Divine Commander from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Divine Commander (Warpriest Archetype)" but are not part of the Warpriest Divine Commander entry, which is unchanged.

Not all warpriests are called to fight in the trenches, being a single sword against their enemies. Some are called to lead the faithful in glorious battle. The divine commander exhorts their allies with their divinely inspire battle cries and charge with them into the lines of their foes.

Mount (Ex)

All blessings that benefit the legendary warpriest also benefit their mount with no extra fervor needing to be used.

This ability replaces weapons of the faithful and the blessings gained at 7th and 15th levels.

Battle Tactician (Ex)

If using mass combat rules, the divine commander also gains the following. If mass combat rules are not used in your game, do not replace the 15th level blessing with this ability.

Bless Army (Su)

At 15th level, a divine commander can raise their faith symbol high and give a blessing to the army they are leading. The divine commander’s army gains a +1 bonus to the army’s OM and DV. This is a sacred bonus if the legendary warpriest is good-aligned, and it is a profane bonus if the legendary warpriest is evil-aligned, if the legendary warpriest is neutral, they choose which kind of bonus when gaining this ability.
